abs_traction.definition: The grip between the tyre and the road, and it is what turns the car's speed into a stop.
abs_traction.example: There is little traction on ice, so the car slides even at a low speed.

backpack.definition: A bag with two straps that you carry on your back to school.
backpack.example: My backpack has two wide straps.

bonus.definition: A payment that depends on results, usually agreed at the start of the year.
bonus.example: I asked whether a higher bonus could work instead of a permanent increase.

er_unspoken_contract.definition: The set of rules a relationship runs on although nobody has written them down or said them aloud.
er_unspoken_contract.example: Their unspoken contract said that the person who plans also drives.

msa_age_gap.definition: The difference in age between two partners, and the direction of that difference.
msa_age_gap.example: The age gap was four years, and she was the older one.

room_key.definition: The card or fob that opens your door. In many hotels it also works as your room number, your lift pass and your breakfast voucher.
room_key.example: Could I have a second key card for my colleague?

tokenizer.definition: The fixed vocabulary a model uses, plus the rule that splits text into tokens and joins them back.
tokenizer.example: A different tokenizer means the same text costs a different number of tokens.

vet.definition: A person whose job is to treat sick animals and to help keep them healthy.
vet.example: The vet says the puppy needs two more injections.

wh_scald.definition: A burn caused by hot liquid or steam.
wh_scald.example: Water at 60 °C can scald a child in a few seconds.
